memos.skeptic:

The curve data is a red flag: bundle_share is 1.0 and top3_share is 1.0, meaning the early supply was controlled by a handful of coordinated wallets. The first two minutes after graduation show a launch bot present, 136.8 SOL of buys from only 21 buyers, and a top-5 buyer share of 99.2%. Sellers already appear: 276 sellers over the last 15 minutes against 168 SOL of buys, with 57 SOL sold. A 0.0029 sell-to-buy ratio at graduation means the insiders were not yet selling then, so this is a warning sign, not proof of a dump.

At a $20 ticket, a 1.4-5.1% round-trip cost plus a 30-second execution lag makes any small move hard to capture. Buying after a 20x return with a 0% drawdown from the 30-minute high risks buying the top just as the coordinated holders begin distributing.

Verdict: skip.
